data.question: long surname keeps wrapping, is the pdf gonna chop it off at the end???

spans.text: The PDF won't silently chop off long surnames.

Always preview names with long surnames in the tool to confirm layout.
For unsupported cases, you may need to adjust the name format or check if the script is compatible.

- Check calibration with the dedicated print-test PDF first
